subject: Architecture
title: Cantilever Bridges: Reaching from Both Sides
description: A quick win: understand Cantilever Bridges: Reaching from Both Sides.

hook.text: A cantilever bridge works like two diving boards reaching toward each other from opposite banks.

buildup.text: Each arm extends outward from a pier, balanced by a counterweight on the opposite side of the support.

discovery.text: A short 'suspended span' connects the two cantilever arms in the middle, completing the bridge.

twist.text: The Quebec Bridge collapsed twice during construction — killing 88 workers before the design was corrected.

climax.text: The Forth Bridge proved the cantilever concept with a live demo — two men balanced a third between chairs.

punchline.text: Two arms reach out and meet in the middle. Balance is everything.

quiz.question: What disaster struck the Quebec Bridge during construction?
options: A flood washed out the foundations
